scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build --workspace @ticketly/shared && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @ticketly/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ticketly/shared && npm run build --workspace @ticketly/api && npm run build --workspace @ticketly/web
